items.q: And Teal. George Mackey. George Mackey. But George Mackey. Lawrence and Teal. Yeah, they played B and A clarinet

ctx.x: And Teal. George Mackey. George Mackey. But George Mackey. Lawrence and Teal. Yeah, they played B and A clarinet, but Louis used only C, played the violin, played the violin part. Yeah. He played the lead sheet all the time.
And who was the first one to start to play that other style of, you know, the chords and the arpeggio?
